successCriteria.description: PgBalanceRepository implements every method declared in IBalanceRepository (findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear, create, update, deductDays) using parameterized SQL queries against the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts

deductDays(id, days) throws BalanceNotFoundError (code 'NOT_FOUND') when no balance row matches the given id, and throws InsufficientBalanceError (code 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE') when remaining_days is less than the requested days — it never returns null
deductDays atomically decrements remaining_days and increments used_days by the requested days, and sets status to 'exhausted' (BalanceStatus.exhausted) when remaining_days reaches 0 after deduction

BalanceService implements IBalanceService: getBalance delegates to repo.findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, hasSufficientBalance returns true iff remainingDays >= requestedDays, deductBalance delegates to repo.deductDays
PgAuditLogRepository implements every method declared in IAuditLogRepository (findByEntity, create, findAll with optional filters) using parameterized SQL queries against the pg Pool

Balance controller exposes endpoints that return balance data for an employee; RBAC is enforced via requireRole middleware (employees see their own, managers see their direct reports, hr_admin sees all)
Unit tests exist for PgBalanceRepository (mock pg Pool), BalanceService (mock IBalanceRepository), and PgAuditLogRepository (mock pg Pool) covering all methods including error paths

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer — no inline SQL in services, controllers, or route handlers (GP-001)
Repository methods must use parameterized queries ($1, $2, …) — no string interpolation of user-supplied values into SQL
No unhandled promise rejections — all async errors must be caught and surfaced as typed domain errors (GP-006)
outOfScope: Leave-request module (Phase 5/6) — balance deduction orchestration during leave approval lives in LeaveRequestService, not in this phase
Notification module (Phase 5/6) — no notification creation or dispatch in this phase

ambiguities.description: PLAN.md states balance routes "should be registered in src/app.ts in a follow-up integration phase or as part of this phase if the app.ts already supports plugin registration." Since app.ts already uses app.register() for uptimeRoutes, the balance routes plugin could be registered in this phase or deferred. The code agent should decide based on whether the controller+route files are produced.
options: Register balance routes in app.ts in this phase
Defer app.ts registration to a follow-up integration phase

entityInvariants.invariant: remainingDays must always equal totalEntitlement - usedDays; any mutation to usedDays or totalEntitlement must recalculate remainingDays accordingly
status must be 'active' when remainingDays > 0 and 'exhausted' when remainingDays === 0; the deductDays operation must enforce this transition
Every AuditLog entry must have a non-empty entityType, entityId, action, and performedBy; changes must be a plain object (Record<string, unknown>) — never null or undefined

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws BalanceNotFoundError (code 'NOT_FOUND') when no row matches id; throws InsufficientBalanceError (code 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE') when remaining_days < days; returns the updated Balance on success — never returns null
Delegates to IBalanceRepository.deductDays; propagates BalanceNotFoundError and InsufficientBalanceError from the repository layer
Returns Balance | null — null when no balance row exists for the given employeeId + leaveType combination (no error thrown for missing balance)

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Balance entity shape must match the reconciled architecture: id, employeeId, leaveType, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays, fiscalYear, status (BalanceStatus), createdAt, updatedAt — as declared in balance.model.ts
Repository implementations must use the pg Pool exported from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no separate pool creation

Error classes InsufficientBalanceError (code 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE') and BalanceNotFoundError (code 'NOT_FOUND') already defined in balance.model.ts must be used — no new error classes for the same semantics
AuditLog entity shape must match the reconciled architecture: id, entityType, entityId, action, performedBy, changes (Record<string, unknown>), createdAt — as declared in audit-log.model.ts

integrationPoints.why: PgBalanceRepository and PgAuditLogRepository must import the shared pg Pool for all database operations
Balance entity uses BalanceStatus enum; repository must import it for status transitions (active ↔ exhausted)
